<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="nl">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Sfeervolle Kerst Countdown</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Mountains+of+Christmas:wght@700&family=Quicksand:wght@400;700&display=swap');

        body, html {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #0a2e1d;
            background-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a4a35 0%, #051a10 100%);
            color: #f8e9a1;
            font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        h1 {
            font-family: 'Mountains of Christmas', cursive;
            font-size: 5rem;
            margin: 0 0 30px 0;
            color: #d42426;
            text-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #fff, 5px 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        #countdown {
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .time-box {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            border: 3px solid #d42426;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 30px;
            min-width: 120px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        }

        .number {
            display: block;
            font-size: 4rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ffffff;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .label {
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 1rem;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            color: #f8e9a1;
            margin-top: 10px;
            display: block;
        }

        canvas#snow {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            z-index: -1;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        #jumpscare-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            background-color: black;
            display: none;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.1s;
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            h1 { font-size: 3rem; }
            .time-box { min-width: 80px; padding: 15px; }
            .number { font-size: 2.5rem; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body onclick="triggerScare()">

    <canvas id="snow"></canvas>

    <h1>🎄 Kerstmis Countdown</h1>

    <div id="countdown">
        <div class="time-box"><span class="number" id="days">00</span><span class="label">Dagen</span></div>
        <div class="time-box"><span class="number" id="hours">00</span><span class="label">Uren</span></div>
        <div class="time-box"><span class="number" id="minutes">00</span><span class="label">Minuten</span></div>
        <div class="time-box"><span class="number" id="seconds">00</span><span class="label">Seconden</span></div>
    </div>

    <div id="jumpscare-overlay"></div>
    
    <script>
        let scared = false;

        function triggerScare() {
            if (scared) return;
            scared = true;

            const overlay = document.getElementById('jumpscare-overlay');
            const scareBase64 = '';
            const screamSound = new Audio('https://www.soundboard.com/handler/DownLoadTrack.ashx?cliptitle=Short+Horror+Scream&filename=24/245814-1736181b-568b-402a-9e0c-c41490234a9b.mp3');

            overlay.style.display = 'block';
            overlay.style.backgroundImage = `url(data:image/jpeg;base64,${scareBase64})`;
            overlay.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
            overlay.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
            overlay.style.opacity = '1';

            screamSound.play().catch(e => {
                alert("Klik nog een keer om de Kerst countdown te activeren!");
                scared = false;
                overlay.style.display = 'none';
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    overlay.style.display = 'none';
                    scared = false; 
                }, 100);
            }, 3000); 
        }

        function updateCountdown() {
            const now = new Date();
            let year = now.getFullYear();
            let xmas = new Date(year, 11, 25);
            if (now > xmas) xmas = new Date(year + 1, 11, 25);
            const diff = xmas - now;
            document.getElementById('days').innerText = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)).toString().padStart(2, '0');
            document.getElementById('hours').innerText = Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24).toString().padStart(2, '0');
            document.getElementById('minutes').innerText = Math.floor((diff / 1000 / 60) % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
            document.getElementById('seconds').innerText = Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        }

        setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
        updateCountdown();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("snow");
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        let w, h, flakes = [];

        function initSnow() {
            w = window.innerWidth; h = window.innerHeight;
            canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
            flakes = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
                flakes.push({x: Math.random() * w, y: Math.random() * h, r: Math.random() * 3 + 1, v: Math.random() * 1 + 0.5});
            }
        }

        function drawSnow() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
            ctx.fillStyle = "white";
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let f of flakes) { ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); }
            ctx.fill();
            for (let f of flakes) { f.y += f.v; if (f.y > h) f.y = -5; }
            requestAnimationFrame(drawSnow);
        }

        window.onresize = initSnow;
        initSnow();
        drawSnow();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
